criteria_verification.notes: Realm 'study-tutor' with pinned ID 'study-tutor-realm-001' and sslRequired='all' verified by tests test_realm_name_is_study_tutor, test_realm_id_is_pinned, test_ssl_required_is_all. Client IDs also pinned.

study-tutor-app client configured as public with PKCE S256 and offline_access; reachy-robot configured as public with device grant. Verified by tests test_study_tutor_app_is_public_with_pkce, test_study_tutor_app_has_offline_access, test_reachy_robot_is_public_with_device_grant.

Realm roles 'student' and 'parent' exist with pinned IDs role-student-001 and role-parent-001. Verified by tests test_student_role_exists, test_parent_role_exists, test_student_role_has_pinned_id, test_parent_role_has_pinned_id.

student_id protocol mapper (oidc-usermodel-attribute-mapper) defined on both clients, mapping user.attribute='student_id' to claim.name='student_id' in access/id/userinfo tokens. Verified by tests test_study_tutor_app_mapper_configuration, test_reachy_robot_mapper_configuration.

JSON is valid, properly formatted with 2-space indentation, and contains all required Keycloak fields. Verified by tests test_json_is_valid, test_json_is_properly_formatted, test_required_keycloak_fields_present.

rationale: All 6 acceptance criteria verified through 51 passing tests. The realm JSON configuration is complete, correctly structured, and production-safe.
